verdicts.human_summary: RESET_STORY_ARGS + incrementing resetKey triggers two separate render paths for one click, causing double rendering. Should remove the local resetKey remount path.
verdicts.reasoning: The human comment identifies a dual-mechanism problem: RESET_STORY_ARGS already drives a rerender, and resetKey adds a redundant second one. The AI comments (0 and 2) make a different diagnosis — they claim RESET_STORY_ARGS doesn't remount at all and should be replaced with FORCE_REMOUNT. These are fundamentally different concerns with different fixes (remove resetKey vs. change event type). No AI comment addresses the double-rendering redundancy issue.
